content.title: The Nature of the Atonement and its Relation to Remission of Sins and Eternal Life (1856)
content.author: John McLeod Campbell · second edition (London: Macmillan, 1867)
content.note: A Church of Scotland minister, deposed in 1831 for teaching that Christ died for all, argues that the atonement is Christ's perfect confession of our sin and his full assent, in our humanity, to God's judgment on it, rather than penal substitution. Cited to describe his view; the site does not adopt it. Public domain (Campbell died 1872).
